title: feat(state): register the nuryel.state/1 facets as additive store kinds
context:
receipts, commitments, derived, entities, relationships join ENTITY_KINDS
at the end; every registry-driven path (JSON store, overlay safety,
private migrate, reindex, dropAll) picks them up unchanged. Entities and
relationships are index-file stored like resources because kind-qualified
ids are not safe file names. The gitignore writer whitelists the new
directories; this repo's own whitelist too.

The record schemas move to src/core/stateRecords.ts and provenance +
credential-free text to src/ Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_947c578b2c (Forward-migrate raw JSON to the current schema BEFORE Zod validation; never silently drop unmigratable records); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Introduced src/core, src/integrations, src/store, test/state-kinds.test.ts: added Provenance, isCredentialFreeText, isCredentialFreeValue, credentialFree, Scope, ExternalRef, DependencyRef, ActionReceipt; removed credentialFree, Scope, ExternalRef, DependencyRef, ActionReceipt, Commitment, DerivedState, ExternalEntity; new dep(s): zod, node:test, node:assert/strict, node:fs, node:path; 3 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: zod, node:test, node:assert/strict, node:fs, node:path.

Removes credentialFree, Scope, ExternalRef, DependencyRef, ActionReceipt, Commitment, DerivedState, ExternalEntity, StateRelationship, Provenance, isCredentialFreeText — potential breaking change for callers.
